name: TX-29
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with a +17 partisan lean
Incumbent Sylvia Garcia running for reelection with a large fundraising edge
Republican challenger Martha Fierro has raised no money
No independent polling available for this race
model.rationale: Garcia holds a Houston-area seat with a +17 Democratic lean, has out-raised her opponent by roughly $1 million to zero, and enjoys outside support with no opposition spending. Markets price her near certain, and no evidence points to an upset.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending against Garcia showing a single-digit race would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Sylvia Garcia seeks another term in a Houston-area district that leans Democratic by about 17 points. She enters the general election with roughly $1 million raised and more than $560,000 in outside support, while Republican Martha Fierro has reported no fundraising and no outside backing. No independent groups are spending against the incumbent.

No public polls cover the race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the money gap, and markets that price Garcia's chances near certain. The combination points to a comfortable double-digit win for Garcia, with the main uncertainty being the absence of direct polling rather than any sign of a competitive race.
